items.reason: Both describe missing connectedCalendars query invalidation after cache deletion, leaving stale cache status visible.
Both identify the macOS-only sed invocation failing on Linux and leaving GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL unchanged.
This describes potential exposure of googleChannelId through a shared user query, which no golden-set issue covers.
Both identify the hard-coded en-US locale used to format the cache timestamp instead of the user's locale.
Both describe the stale migration warning that contradicts the SQL's DEFAULT NOW().

The broader comment includes the same empty-data update that fails to refresh SelectedCalendar.updatedAt, and suggests explicitly setting the timestamp.
